title: seekrit — secrets for agents
description: Encrypted store for API keys and database URLs your code needs. Use them without reading them.
summary: Encrypted store for API keys and database URLs your code needs. Use them without reading them.
offersHint: Encrypted store for API keys and database URLs your code needs. Use them without reading them. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.seekrit.dev/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Leave unset to connect anonymously — the tool list and instructions are public, and the `signup` tool mints your own credential. Once you have one: HTTP Basic, base64(clientId:clientSecret).

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Optional. Leave unset to connect anonymously — the tool list and instructions are public, and the `signup` tool mints your own credential. Once you have one: HTTP Basic, base64(clientId:clientSecret).

toolsPreview.name: signup
toolsPreview.description: Create a seekrit workspace and your own machine credential — one call, no human, no browser. Binds the credential to this session, so every other tool works on your next call with no config change and no reconnect. Save the returned clientId + clientSecret: the secret is shown once and is how you reconnect later. Call this if a tool says you have no credential.

toolsPreview.name: get_started
toolsPreview.description: The recommended first-project recipe: what to provision here vs. encrypt locally, end to end. Call this before provisioning.

toolsPreview.name: setup_local_crypto
toolsPreview.description: How to run the local crypto plane (the `@seekrit/mcp` npm server, the CLI, or seekrit-run) so you can set and use secret values — with a copy-paste .mcp.json. Call this the moment you need a secret's value.

toolsPreview.name: local_tool_for
toolsPreview.description: Given a crypto-plane operation this hosted server can't do (e.g. set_secret, create_env, run_command), return exactly how to do it locally. Use when a tool you expected is missing here.

toolsPreview.name: whoami
toolsPreview.description: Show the authenticated machine client and the org it can access. Call this first.

toolsPreview.name: list_orgs
toolsPreview.description: List organizations the caller can access.

toolsPreview.name: list_apps
toolsPreview.description: List applications in an organization.

toolsPreview.name: list_envs
toolsPreview.description: List environments of an application (names + slugs only, never values).

toolsPreview.name: list_branches
toolsPreview.description: List ephemeral branch configs (per-PR / preview environments) in an application, or of one environment. Names, parents, and expiry only — never values.

toolsPreview.name: list_groups
toolsPreview.description: List shared groups (reusable secret bags) in an organization.

toolsPreview.name: list_group_envs
toolsPreview.description: List a group's environments (per-slug value sets).

toolsPreview.name: list_env_groups
toolsPreview.description: List the groups composed into an application environment (precedence order).

toolsPreview.name: list_members
toolsPreview.description: List organization members and their public keys (used when granting access locally).

toolsPreview.name: list_secrets
toolsPreview.description: List secret names + versions in an environment. NEVER returns values — reading a value happens on the local crypto plane (see setup_local_crypto).

toolsPreview.name: list_secret_versions
toolsPreview.description: List a secret's version history: who wrote each version, when, and which ones were restores. Metadata only — never values. Pair with restore_secret to undo a bad write.

toolsPreview.name: list_tokens
toolsPreview.description: List an organization's service tokens (metadata only — never the token strings).

toolsPreview.name: list_invites
toolsPreview.description: List pending invitations to join the organization.

toolsPreview.name: kms_list_keys
toolsPreview.description: List managed KMS keys the caller can see (metadata only — key material is fetched + used locally).

toolsPreview.name: list_lease_targets
toolsPreview.description: List registered temporary-access provisioning targets (Postgres, MySQL, …).

toolsPreview.name: list_leases
toolsPreview.description: List temporary-access leases (the ledger — never secret material).

toolsPreview.name: audit
toolsPreview.description: Read the organization's audit trail (most recent first).

toolsPreview.name: billing
toolsPreview.description: Show the org's plan, effective entitlements, current usage, and which upgrade actions are available. Read this if a create action was refused with a plan limit.

toolsPreview.name: create_app
toolsPreview.description: Create an application in an organization. Keyless — then create its environments on the local crypto plane (create_env mints the data key locally).

toolsPreview.name: create_group
toolsPreview.description: Create a shared group (reusable secret bag) in an organization. Keyless.

toolsPreview.name: compose_group
toolsPreview.description: Compose a group into an application environment (higher position wins on name clashes). Keyless.

toolsPreview.name: uncompose_group
toolsPreview.description: Remove a composed group from an application environment. Keyless.

toolsPreview.name: invite_member
toolsPreview.description: Invite someone to the organization by email (admin only). They join at the given role once they sign in.

toolsPreview.name: rename_app
toolsPreview.description: Rename an application's display name (the slug is immutable). Keyless.

toolsPreview.name: rename_group
toolsPreview.description: Rename a group's display name (the slug is immutable). Keyless.

toolsPreview.name: restore_secret
toolsPreview.description: Roll a secret back to an earlier version (see list_secret_versions). The stored ciphertext is replayed as a NEW version — history is append-only, nothing is overwritten. Keyless: no decryption happens, so this works here on the metadata plane.

toolsPreview.name: delete_secret
toolsPreview.description: Delete a secret from an environment. Removes ciphertext — no key needed. Irreversible except by re-setting it (locally).

toolsPreview.name: revoke_token
toolsPreview.description: Revoke a service token by id. Future DEK fetches stop immediately. Rotate the environment (locally) if the holder may have cached the key.

toolsPreview.name: revoke_invite
toolsPreview.description: Revoke a pending organization invitation.

toolsPreview.name: revoke_lease
toolsPreview.description: Revoke a temporary-access lease now (drops the credential immediately).

toolsPreview.name: kms_disable_key
toolsPreview.description: Disable a managed KMS key (blocks new operations; existing ciphertexts stay decryptable locally by grantees). Keyless.

toolsPreview.name: kms_revoke_grant
toolsPreview.description: Revoke a principal's grant on a managed KMS key (all versions). Keyless — the caller needs no key material to remove a grant.

toolsPreview.name: delete_app
toolsPreview.description: Delete an application and all its environments/secrets. Removes ciphertext — keyless — but irreversible. Confirm intent before calling.

toolsPreview.name: delete_group
toolsPreview.description: Delete a group and its environments/secrets. Removes ciphertext — keyless — but irreversible. Confirm intent before calling.

toolsPreview.name: delete_env
toolsPreview.description: Delete an application environment and its secrets. Removes ciphertext — keyless — but irreversible. Confirm intent before calling.

toolsPreview.name: delete_branch
toolsPreview.description: Tear down an ephemeral branch config and every value it overrode. Keyless (it removes ciphertext, never reads it), and the parent environment is untouched. Creating a branch mints a data key, so that stays on the local crypto plane.
